# Zeftawii | Decoding Data

> Data analyst and Business Intelligence specialist (Albaraa Ehab Elzeftawy) serving businesses in Saudi Arabia and Egypt. Arabic-first, English supported.

## Services
- Dashboards and Business Intelligence (Power BI and web dashboards)
- Marketing analytics (CPA, ROAS, funnel analysis, campaign reporting)
- Report automation and data cleaning (Python, SQL, advanced Excel)
- Smart tools and predictive models
- Account management (outsourced account manager for agencies and companies)
- Project management for marketing and digital projects

## Track record
- Managed delivery and close-out of 23 website and store projects in 2026 (WordPress and Salla), median 36 days from kickoff to sign-off
- Built AMMS, a production account-management monitoring system for a marketing agency
- Public analysis notebooks: https://github.com/albraa2002

## Who it is for
- E-commerce stores (ROAS, CPA, COD returns analysis)
- Marketing agencies and service businesses (automated client reports, scope protection)
- Companies with scattered data (unified KPI dashboards)
